name: WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp. Ordinary Shares
summary: WISeSat.Space Holdings Corp. is a holding company being formed to own WISeSat.Space Corp. and its operating subsidiary, WISeSat.Space AG. WISeSat is an early-stage space technology company developing secure satellite infrastructure and space-based services for trusted communications, digital identity, secure data exchange, and other security-sensitive applications. Its technology combines low Earth orbit satellite connectivity with post-quantum security, authentication, and digital identity capabilities, targeting sovereign, defense, critical-infrastructure, and other high-integrity applications.
